title: The Ghost of Tashkent
author: Isandro Brightwater
blurb: Freya Oyelaran, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
